_meta.scope: Deals tab: Type G checks on shipped opportunities (janus, eielson, equinix-radiant, oklo-switch); new buyer deals dated after 2026-10-14 not in skip/news.json
angles_run: Type G: Army Janus site assignments (fetched DefenseScoop 2026-08-26)
Type G: Eielson ANPI / Oklo NOITA status (fetched Oklo Q2 2026 10-Q)
Type G: Equinix-Radiant preorder (fetched Equinix 2025-08-14 release)
Type G: Oklo-Switch binding status (fetched Oklo Q2 2026 10-Q)
Type N: new buyer deals after 2026-10-14, general microreactor PPA/MOU/LOI queries
Type N: named-vendor sweeps (NANO, Last Energy, Valar, Aalo, Deep Fission, Oklo, Kairos, X-energy, Radiant, Antares, BWXT, Westinghouse, Deployable Energy)

absences: No buyer deal (PPA, MOU, LOI, contract or site selection) dated 2026-10-15 to 2026-10-21 surfaced in any of the searches, so no Type N items were written.
Last Energy: a search result about a Llynfi (South Wales) four-unit plan showed an 'October 15' date with no year; the context pointed to 2025, so it was not used.
GridMarket and Deployable Energy partnership (2026-07-07) is dated before the cutoff and is not in skip/news.json; excluded as out of window.

Equinix-Radiant: the Radiant release 'Radiant Announces Equinix Preorder & Deposits for 20 Kaleidos Microreactors' returned HTTP 403 on fetch; the deposit wording rests on its search-result title only.

Oklo-Switch: the 2024 master agreement's non-binding framework language comes from search summaries; the fetched 2026 Oklo 10-Q names Switch only as a prospective customer and does not describe the agreement's terms.

Eielson: the fetched Oklo 10-Q (Q2 2026) excerpt gives no filing date; the cover page share count is dated 2026-08-04. The NRC licensing condition and 30-year contract terms were not found in the excerpt read.
Janus: Holston Army Ammunition Plant and Redstone Arsenal remain unassigned; no later Army award for either was found.
ANPI Joint Base San Antonio, Buckley and Malmstrom: not re-checked within budget; shipped status left as is.
DOE Reactor Pilot Program, Equinix-Radiant power (MW per unit), NANO-Supermicro MOU, Canada SRC and the Texas backup program: not checked within budget.

checks.claim: Antares (Fort Bragg), Radiant (Benning), BWXT (Campbell), General Atomics (Hood), Westinghouse (Drum); four of the nine sites are still unassigned
checks.evidence: DefenseScoop, 2026-08-26: the Army named five installations, paired with Antares, BWXT, General Atomics, Radiant and Westinghouse (Forts Bragg, Campbell, Hood, Benning and Drum). Four short-listed installations were not chosen, and the article says the initiative is expected to expand to other bases.

sources.label: DefenseScoop — Army announces initial bases to host nuclear microreactors (2026-08-26)
sources.quote: the initial five installations that have been selected to host nuclear microreactors as part of the Janus program

checks.evidence: Oklo's Q2 2026 Form 10-Q (cover share count dated 2026-08-04) says a Notice of Intent to Award has been issued by the Defense Logistics Agency-Energy, tentatively selecting Oklo for Eielson. The filing does not show a signed contract.

sources.label: Oklo Inc. — Form 10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-06-30 (SEC EDGAR)
sources.quote: tentatively selecting Oklo to provide electricity and heat to Eielson Air Force Base

checks.evidence: Equinix's 2025-08-14 release describes a preorder agreement for the purchase of 20 Kaleidos microreactors. Radiant's matching release is titled 'Radiant Announces Equinix Preorder & Deposits for 20 Kaleidos Microreactors' (search-result title only; the page returned HTTP 403 on fetch, so the deposit element is not fetched).

sources.label: Equinix investor release — Equinix collaborates with leading alternative energy providers (2025-08-14)
sources.quote: Today Equinix announced a preorder agreement for the purchase of 20 of Radiant's Kaleidos microreactors.

checks.evidence: Oklo's Q2 2026 Form 10-Q lists Switch among 'prospective customers', not as a signed customer. No executed Switch power purchase agreement appears in the filing excerpt read. The 2024 release describes the master agreement as a framework with individual binding agreements to follow.

sources.label: Oklo Inc. — Form 10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-06-30 (SEC EDGAR)
sources.quote: potentially including prospective customers such as Meta, Equinix, Diamondback Energy, Prometheus Hyperscale, Switch
